## Progress

- Merged [PR #77](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/77): `GET /v1/schedule/week` (one doctor or resource, Monday–Sunday, every day built like the day view from one batched read on the (facility, start) index, capacity per day, audited, facility capability and calendar checked); day bounds and ISO week as tested rules (IST, GST, DST 23/25 h); Day/Week/List switch and doctor/resource filter, a doctor starts on their own column; list default at ≤ 767 px with a pinned Book at the next free slot; every state an icon + words (dashed No-show/Cancelled, hatched Unavailable) with a legend; the list prints as an agenda; en/hi/ar, RTL
- Measured: day/week reads p95 29/33 ms through the endpoints with a fully booked year for 3 doctors (16,380 visits); 3-doctor day first render ≈ 2.2 s on the production build over Lighthouse throttled 4G (Playwright budget in CI)
- Tested on SQL Server (week = day, local-midnight boundary, facility scoping) and in the browser against a real API (en/ar, keyboard, axe at 1280/1024/820/640/390 px); 14 mutations each caught
- Merged [PR #85](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/85): two e2e races fixed (week list read before render, axe sampling a colour mid-transition), no assertion weakened; [PR #87](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/87): Hindi and Arabic catalogs load on demand, so first paint carries one catalog — CI first render 2502 → 2315 ms against the 2500 ms budget
- Left: the first-render and read budgets on staging under the P1 load profile (MDV-P1-037)

## Description

Day view with columns per doctor/resource and time rows; week view per doctor; list view (agenda) for mobile and printing. Appointment chips show name, type, time and state with icon + label (Booked, Checked in, In room, Completed, No-show dashed, Cancelled dashed, Unavailable hatched). Doctor filter, date navigation, today button. Doctors see their own schedule view (read-only booking actions per permissions).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Calendar first render < 2.5 s on a clinic PC over throttled 4G for a 3-doctor day (Lighthouse/Playwright perf budget).
- [ ] **AC2.** States are distinguishable without colour (icon + label) and announced to screen readers; empty slots are buttons with accessible names like "Book Dr. Arjun Rao at 10:20".
- [ ] **AC3.** Week and list views show the same appointments as day view (consistency test).
- [ ] **AC4.** At ≤ 767 px the list/agenda view is the default with a pinned "+ Book" action.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
